prompt: Create a compact US streaming guide for the 2026/27 Premier League, Serie A, LaLiga and Bundesliga. Show each league, its major services/channels, coverage caveats and source attribution. Research current rights. Use only primitive Card, Stack, Text, Badge, Row, Disclosure and SegmentedControl; no sports templates. Make a polished Kino component with expandable coverage details. No prices. Explicitly label United States and as-of date.
